entries.title: Institution pages, version 2
entries.body: A fuller institution page layout is rolling out to all FI pages today.

entries.title: What's new and a public roadmap
entries.body: A What's new page keeps dated, plain-language release notes, and a public Roadmap page shows what is live, being built, or queued, with estimated dates.

entries.title: Vendor platform change feed
entries.body: A new Vendor platform changes page collects public notices about digital banking platforms and lists institutions that may be affected, based on a login-page scan. The first entry is Jack Henry's planned retirement of NetTeller Online Banking and Cash Management on July 1, 2027.

entries.title: Territory view
entries.body: A new Territory page lists banks with assets strictly above $1.4 billion and an Eastern Time headquarters, grouped by HQ city, with the rule published on the page. The same view is a URL filter on the board and in the directory.

entries.title: Provider fields on institution pages
entries.body: Every institution page now has a Technology providers section. Digital banking comes from a login-page scan or a verified announcement; core is listed only when we have a verified public source.
